question: What are the core working hours at TechNova?
ground_truth_answer: Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00 in the employee's local time zone.

question: How many hours per week are employees expected to work on average?
ground_truth_answer: Employees are expected to work an average of 40 hours per week.

question: What is the policy for meetings held outside core hours?
ground_truth_answer: Meetings outside core hours should be recorded so remote colleagues can catch up.

question: How many days per week are employees allowed to work remotely?
ground_truth_answer: Employees may work remotely up to four days per week.

question: What must an employee do if working from another country for over 30 days?
ground_truth_answer: Notify the People team first due to potential tax obligations for both parties.

question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees accrue per year?
ground_truth_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave accrued at 2 days per month.

question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried over into the next year?
ground_truth_answer: Up to five unused leave days may be carried over and must be used before 31 March.

question: Within how many days are annual leave requests normally approved?
ground_truth_answer: Leave requests are submitted in the People portal and approved within three working days.

question: How many paid sick leave days are provided each year?
ground_truth_answer: Employees receive up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.

question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave?
ground_truth_answer: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than three consecutive working days.

question: Do mental health days count as sick leave?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, mental health days count as sick leave and reasons do not need to be explained.

question: What is the paid parental leave duration for primary and secondary caregivers?
ground_truth_answer: 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.

question: Can parental leave be taken in separate blocks?
ground_truth_answer: Parental leave can be taken in up to three separate blocks during the first 18 months.

question: What part-time arrangement is offered to employees returning from parental leave?
ground_truth_answer: Returning employees may work a reduced four-day week at 80% pay for the first 3 months.

question: What is the annual learning budget provided to each employee?
ground_truth_answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1500 USD.

question: Does the annual learning budget carry over to the next year?
ground_truth_answer: No, the learning budget does not carry over to the following year.

question: What purchase threshold requires manager pre-approval for the learning budget?
ground_truth_answer: Purchases above 500 USD need manager approval in advance.

question: By what day of the month must expense reimbursement claims be submitted?
ground_truth_answer: Claims must be submitted before the 25th of the month to be paid with that month's payroll.

question: What flight duration qualifies for business class travel?
ground_truth_answer: Flights over six hours may be booked in business class with director approval.

question: What computer options do engineers receive upon joining TechNova?
ground_truth_answer: Engineers may choose between a MacBook Pro and a Dell XPS running Ubuntu.

question: What is the hardware refresh cycle for company laptops?
ground_truth_answer: Laptops are refreshed every three years.

question: What is the home office allowance amount for new hires?
ground_truth_answer: Employees receive a one-time home office allowance of 600 USD for a desk and chair.

question: When do performance review cycles occur at TechNova?
ground_truth_answer: Performance reviews happen twice a year, in March and September.

question: When do compensation changes and promotions take effect?
ground_truth_answer: Decisions are made in the March cycle and take effect on 1 May.

question: Within how many days are Code of Conduct reports investigated?
ground_truth_answer: All reports are investigated within 10 working days.

question: What is NovaCloud and what is its primary use case?
ground_truth_answer: NovaCloud is a platform to build, schedule, and monitor pipelines moving data without managing servers.

question: What are the three main components of NovaCloud?
ground_truth_answer: The platform has three parts: Pipeline Builder, Scheduler, and Observability Hub.

question: What is the current release of NovaCloud and when did it ship?
ground_truth_answer: The current release is NovaCloud 4.2, shipped in February 2024.

question: In what languages can transforms be written in the Pipeline Builder?
ground_truth_answer: Transforms in the Pipeline Builder are written in SQL or Python.

question: What execution time and memory limits apply to Python transforms?
ground_truth_answer: Python transforms run in an isolated sandbox with a 10 minute execution limit and 4 GB of memory.

question: How can pipelines be exported from the visual builder?
ground_truth_answer: Every pipeline can be exported as a YAML file and stored in Git.

question: What retry policy does the Scheduler use for failed pipeline runs?
ground_truth_answer: Failed runs are retried three times with exponential backoff before being marked failed.

question: How long are pipeline metrics retained in the Observability Hub?
ground_truth_answer: Metrics are retained for 13 months on all paid plans.

question: What data quality checks are available in the Observability Hub?
ground_truth_answer: Checks include null checks, uniqueness checks, range checks, and freshness checks.

question: How many pre-built connectors ship with NovaCloud 4.2?
ground_truth_answer: NovaCloud 4.2 ships with 68 pre-built connectors.

question: Can customers build private custom connectors for NovaCloud?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, customers can build private connectors using the Connector SDK visible only in their workspace.

question: What is the monthly price and pipeline allowance of the Starter tier?
ground_truth_answer: Starter costs 99 USD per month and includes 3 pipelines, 1 workspace, and 10 GB transfer.

question: What is included in the Growth subscription tier?
ground_truth_answer: Growth costs 499 USD per month and includes 25 pipelines, 3 workspaces, and 250 GB data transfer.

question: What is the overage rate for data transfer above the tier allowance?
ground_truth_answer: Data transfer above the included allowance is billed at 0.09 USD per GB.

question: What is the maximum number of steps allowed in a single pipeline?
ground_truth_answer: A single pipeline may contain up to 150 steps.

question: What is the maximum file size that can be processed in a single step?
ground_truth_answer: The maximum size of one file processed in a single step is 5 GB.

question: What is the NovaCloud REST API rate limit per workspace?
ground_truth_answer: The REST API is rate limited to 600 requests per minute per workspace.

question: What notification channels are supported for pipeline alerts?
ground_truth_answer: Alerts support email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty, and HTTPS webhooks.

question: Does NovaCloud expose Prometheus metrics?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, NovaCloud exposes a Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint for customer monitoring.

question: How long is the free trial period and what tier does it include?
ground_truth_answer: Free trials last 14 days and include all Growth tier features with no credit card required.

question: When is NovaCloud REST API version v1 scheduled for sunset?
ground_truth_answer: Version v1 is deprecated and will be switched off on 31 December 2024.

question: How much advance notice does TechNova provide before removing an API version?
ground_truth_answer: TechNova gives at least 12 months notice before removing an API version.

question: Who approves the Information Security Policy and how often is it reviewed?
ground_truth_answer: It is reviewed every 12 months by the Security team and approved by the CTO.

question: What is TechNova's minimum password length?
ground_truth_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

question: What password manager is mandatory for employees?
ground_truth_answer: All employees must store work passwords in the company password manager, 1Password.

question: Are passwords rotated on a routine schedule?
ground_truth_answer: No, following NIST guidance, password changes are only forced upon evidence of compromise.

question: Can employees share their work passwords with colleagues?
ground_truth_answer: Sharing passwords with anyone, including colleagues, is strictly prohibited.

question: Are SMS codes accepted as a multi-factor authentication method?
ground_truth_answer: SMS codes are not accepted due to the risk of SIM swapping attacks.

question: What MFA methods are required for production systems?
ground_truth_answer: Hardware security keys or an authenticator app must be used.

question: What default access level do engineers receive to production systems?
ground_truth_answer: Engineers receive read-only access by default under the principle of least privilege.

question: For how long is just-in-time write access granted to production?
ground_truth_answer: Write access to production is granted for a maximum of eight hours via the JIT tool.

question: Within how many hours must departed employee accounts be disabled?
ground_truth_answer: Accounts of employees who leave are disabled within two hours of their final working day.

question: What encryption standard protects customer data in transit?
ground_truth_answer: Customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.

question: What encryption algorithm is used for customer data at rest?
ground_truth_answer: Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.

question: How frequently are customer encryption keys rotated?
ground_truth_answer: Encryption keys are managed in KMS and rotated annually.

question: Is customer data ever permitted to be copied to personal laptops?
ground_truth_answer: Customer data is never copied to a laptop or personal device.

question: After how many minutes of inactivity must company laptop screens lock?
ground_truth_answer: Automatic screen lock activates after five minutes of inactivity.

question: Within how many days must operating system security patches be installed?
ground_truth_answer: Employees must install OS security updates within 14 days of release.

question: Within what timeframe must a suspected security incident be reported?
ground_truth_answer: Anyone suspecting a security incident must report it within one hour.

question: Under GDPR, what is the notification window for confirmed personal data breaches?
ground_truth_answer: Affected customers and supervisory authorities must be notified within 72 hours.

question: What security compliance certifications does TechNova maintain?
ground_truth_answer: TechNova maintains an annual SOC 2 Type II report and is ISO 27001 certified.

question: How frequently are third-party penetration tests carried out?
ground_truth_answer: Penetration tests are conducted by an external firm twice a year.

ground_truth_answer: Training is completed during onboarding and refreshed every 12 months.
